payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a glassmorphic interface with frosted glass effect. Use backdrop blur (10-20px), translucent overlays (rgba 10-30% opacity), vibrant background colors, subtle borders, light source reflection, layered depth. Perfect for modern overlays and cards.
payload.best_for: Modern SaaS, financial dashboards, high-end corporate, lifestyle apps, modal overlays, navigation
payload.css_technical_keywords: backdrop-filter: blur(15px), background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2), -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px), z-index layering for depth
payload.design_system_variables: --blur-amount: 15px, --glass-opacity: 0.15, --border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2), --background: vibrant color, --text-color: light/dark based on BG
payload.do_not_use_for: Low-contrast backgrounds, critical accessibility, performance-limited, dark text on dark
payload.effects_and_animation: Backdrop blur (10-20px), subtle border (1px solid rgba white 0.2), light reflection, Z-depth
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Backdrop-filter blur 10-20px, ☐ Translucent white 15-30% opacity, ☐ Subtle border 1px light, ☐ Vibrant background verified, ☐ Text contrast 4.5:1 checked
payload.keywords: Frosted glass, transparent, blurred background, layered, vibrant background, light source, depth, multi-layer
payload.secondary_colors: Vibrant: Electric Blue #0080FF, Neon Purple #8B00FF, Vivid Pink #FF1493, Teal #20B2AA
